an3.36:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.36:1.4: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati
an3.36:1.5: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā nānābāhāsu gahetvā yamassa rañño dassenti
an3.36:1.6: ayaṃ deva puriso ametteyyo apetteyyo asāmañño abrahmañño na kulejeṭṭhāpacāyī
an3.36:2.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave yamo rājā paṭhamaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjati samanuggāhati samanubhāsati
an3.36:2.2: ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu paṭhamaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtanti.
an3.36:3.2: ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā asītikaṃ vā navutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantaṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valitaṃ tilakāhatagattanti.
an3.36:4.2: ambho purisa tassa te viññussa sato mahallakassa na etadahosi
an3.36:4.3: ahaṃpi khomhi jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto handāhaṃ kalyāṇaṃ karomi kāyena vācāya manasāti.
an3.36:5.2: ambho purisa pamādavatāya na kalyāṇamakāsi kāyena vācāya manasā
an3.36:5.3: taggha taṃ ambho purisa tathā karissanti yathātaṃ pamattaṃ
an3.36:5.4: taṃ kho panetaṃ pāpakammaṃ neva mātarā kataṃ na pitarā kataṃ na bhātarā kataṃ na bhaginiyā kataṃ na mittāmaccehi kataṃ na ñātisālohitehi kataṃ na devatāhi kataṃ na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṃ
an3.36:5.5: athakho tayāvetaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ tvaññeva tassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedissasīti.
an3.36:6.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave yamo rājā paṭhamaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjitvā samanuggāhitvā samanubhāsitvā dutiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjati samanuggāhati samanubhāsati
an3.36:6.2: ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu dutiyaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtanti.
an3.36:6.6: ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ābādhikaṃ dukkhitaṃ bāḷhagilānaṃ sake muttakarīse palipannaṃ semānaṃ aññehi vuṭṭhāpiyamānaṃ aññehi saṃvesiyamānanti.
an3.36:7.2: ambho purisa tassa te viññussa sato mahallakassa na etadahosi

an3.36:8.5: athakho tayāvetaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ tvaññeva tassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedissasīti.
an3.36:9.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave yamo rājā dutiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjitvā samanuggāhitvā samanubhāsitvā tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjati samanuggāhati samanubhāsati
an3.36:9.2: ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtanti.
an3.36:10.2: ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ekāhamataṃ vā dvīhamataṃ vā tīhamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbakajātanti.

an3.36:13.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave yamo rājā tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ samanuyuñjitvā samanuggāhitvā samanubhāsitvā tuṇhī hoti.
an3.36:13.2: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā pañcavidhabandhanaṃ nāma kammakaraṇaṃ karonti
an3.36:13.3: tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ hatthe gamenti tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ dutiyasmiṃ hatthe gamenti tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ pāde gamenti tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ dutiyasmiṃ pāde gamenti tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ majjheurasmiṃ gamenti.
an3.36:13.4: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vediyati na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
an3.36:14.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā saṃvesitvā kuṭhārīhi tacchanti.
an3.36:14.2: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vediyati na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
an3.36:15.1: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ ṭhapetvā vāsīhi tacchanti …
an3.36:15.2: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā rathe yojetvā ādittāya bhūmiyā sampajjalitāya sañjotibhūtāya sārentipi paccāsārentipi …
an3.36:15.3: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā mahantaṃ aṅgārapabbataṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sañjotibhūtaṃ āropentipi oropentipi …
an3.36:15.4: tamenaṃ bhikkhave nirayapālā uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti ādittāya sampajjalitāya sañjotibhūtāya. so tattha phenuddehakaṃ paccati.
an3.36:15.5: so tattha phenuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakiṃpi uddhaṃ gacchati sakiṃpi adho gacchati sakiṃpi tiriyaṃ gacchati.
an3.36:15.6: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vediyati na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
an3.36:18.2: ye kira bho loke pāpakāni kammāni karonti te evarūpā vividhā kammakaraṇā kariyanti
an3.36:18.3: aho vatāhaṃ manussattaṃ labheyyaṃ tathāgato ca loke uppajjeyya arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tañcāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ payirupāseyyaṃ
an3.36:18.4: so ca bhagavā dhammaṃ deseyya tassa cāhaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ ājāneyyanti.
an3.36:18.5: taṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave na aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā sutvā evaṃ vadāmi apica kho bhikkhave yadeva me sāmaṃ ñātaṃ sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sāmaṃ viditaṃ tadevāhaṃ vadāmīti.
